title: cleomella oxystyloides
intro: Cleomella oxystyloides, commonly known as the oxystyles cleome, is a plant species that belongs to the Cleomella genus in the family Cleomaceae. The health benefits of Cleomella oxystyloides include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant properties, and show antimicrobial activity against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Cleomella oxystyloides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
